records.issue_text: app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:35 — A feed item without a content field raises on nil.scrub and, with job retries disabled, lets one persistent malformed item prevent every later item from being imported.
records.rationale: poll_feed.rb calls `i.content.scrub` — a feed item lacking a content field (nil) raises NoMethodError, and `sidekiq_options retry: false` plus the lack of any per-item rescue means one malformed item aborts processing of subsequent items. Both the mechanism and the disabled-retry consequence are directly visible in the diff.
records.stripped_text: app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:35 — A feed item without a content field raises on nil.scrub and, with job retries disabled, lets one persistent malformed item prevent every later item from being imported.

records.issue_text: app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:35 — HTML-unescaping feed content and importing it as unsanitized raw HTML turns escaped scripts or event handlers into stored XSS on the forum origin.
records.rationale: The mechanism is verifiable in the diff: poll_feed.rb calls CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub) and passes it to TopicEmbed.import, which creates posts with cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]. Post#cook explicitly returns raw unsanitized for that method ('return raw if cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]'), bypassing the markdown/sanitization pipeline, and embed/best.html.erb renders it via raw post.cooked. Unescaping escaped HTML entities (e.g. <script>) reintroduces executable markup, so feed-supplied content becomes stored XSS rendered on the forum origin.
records.stripped_text: app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:35 — HTML-unescaping feed content and importing it as unsanitized raw HTML turns escaped scripts or event handlers into stored XSS on the forum origin.

records.issue_text: lib/topic_retriever.rb:41 — Every distinct cache miss reparses and imports the full feed item by item, multiplying network, parsing, and database work under concurrent misses.
records.rationale: The diff confirms the mechanism: Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({}) is invoked synchronously in perform_retrieve, and poll_feed iterates the entire feed (rss.items.each) doing imports for every item, with no per-item dedup short-circuit besides content_sha1 in TopicEmbed.import. A concurrent cache miss (retrieved_recently? throttles per embed_url, not the feed) will re-fetch and re-import the whole feed. This is a real, specific performance/scalability concern in newly added code, not an outright correctness defect, so it fits important_non_bug.
